Index.title: Video, music and images

Index.subtitle: Generation and editing
Index.featured_updates_desc: See new releases, promotions and important product updates.
Index.suno_title: Turn one prompt into a track with Suno
Index.suno_desc: Bring people into Audio with the clearest promise: write the vibe, choose Suno, generate a track, intro or instrumental in minutes.
Index.suno_benefit_quality_desc: Use Suno V6 when you want the strongest arrangement and the most polished final result.
Index.suno_benefit_length_desc: Use Suno V6 Mini for a lighter, faster music setup.
Index.suno_benefit_workflow_desc: Choose a preset, adjust the prompt and start generation.
Index.suno_preset_anthem: Energetic electronic festival anthem with massive drop, crowd chants, bright synth leads and a euphoric chorus.
Index.suno_preset_nightdrive: Dreamy synthwave night drive track with pulsing bass, glossy pads, retro drums and cinematic neon atmosphere.
Index.suno_preset_intro: Premium modern podcast intro with confident rhythm, sleek branding energy, short melodic hook and clean instrumental focus.
Index.suno_featured_title: Hear what people can build with Suno here
Index.showcase_desc: Choose a tool and open its workspace.
Index.stack_title: Video, audio and images in one service
Index.stack_desc: One interface for generation, remixing and upscale flows: Suno, ElevenLabs, Kling, Hailuo, Flux, Seedream, Qwen, Ideogram and other models without jumping between tools.
Index.stack_video_desc: Kling, Bytedance, Wan and Hailuo for videos from text, stills and references.
Index.stack_audio_desc: Suno V6 and Gemini/ElevenLabs for music, voice, dubbing and dialogue generation.
Index.stack_image_desc: Flux, Seedream, Qwen, Ideogram, Topaz and Recraft for generation and image enhancement.
Index.footer_title: A fluid footer that still feels like the product.
Index.footer_desc: Full-width, organic, and tuned to the same orange-teal system as the rest of the interface, with links and socials kept clean and readable.
Index.image_to_video_desc: Transform still images into dynamic videos

Images.title: Images
Images.description: Create and edit images from a prompt or a reference.
Images.make_public_tooltip: Make this generation visible to other users in the Explore catalog
Images.placeholder: A magical forest with glowing mushrooms and a tiny unicorn...
Images.google_search_tooltip: Ground the image generation in real-time web information when the prompt depends on current facts.
Images.negative_prompt_placeholder: Describe what should be avoided in the final image...
Images.seed_hint: Use the same number to get closer to a similar result on repeated runs.
Images.num_images_hint: How many image variants to generate in a single run.
Images.error_reference: Please upload a reference image for this model.
Images.max_references_reached: Maximum number of references reached for this model.
Images.hero_desc: Enter a prompt in the sidebar or choose an example below to start.
Images.prompt_help: Describe the scene, lighting, mood, materials and key details you want to see in the final image.
Images.reference_desc_edit: Upload the source image you want to transform or improve.
Images.reference_desc_optional: Add a reference if you want to guide the composition, character or overall visual direction.
Images.output_desc: Choose the frame format and quality for the final image.
Images.public_feed_desc: Show this work in Explore so other users can discover it.

Video.title: Video
Video.description: Pick a model, add the prompt and source files, and the page will show the controls that matter for that type of video.
Video.hero_desc: Choose the format you need: text-to-video, image animation, avatar clips, motion transfer or scene-by-scene video.
Video.make_public_tooltip: Make this generation visible to other users in the Explore catalog
Video.placeholder: A cinematic drone shot over a glowing cyberpunk city...
Video.prompt_optional_placeholder: Optional. Leave it empty if this mode mainly works from the source file.
Video.error_reference: Please upload a reference image for this model.
Video.error_shots: Add at least one shot for this mode.
Video.error_timestamps: Enter the time range in the 3.55,5.55 format.
Video.error_timestamps_range: The selected clip must be between 1 and 4 seconds long.
Video.error_runway_quality: Runway Generate supports 1080p only for 5-second clips.
Video.error_character_prompt: Describe the character for Characters Pro.
Video.error_elements_json: Check the Kling Elements block: the format is invalid.
Video.sound_desc: Adds a soundtrack or sound effects when the model supports it.
Video.remove_watermark_desc: Requests a clean result for supported models.
Video.camera_fixed_desc: Reduces camera motion and keeps the shot more stable.
Video.fixed_lens_desc: Helps Seedance keep the lens feel and composition calmer.
Video.generate_audio_desc: Adds an audio track when the model supports it.
Video.safety_checker_desc: Keeps the built-in content safety check enabled.
Video.prompt_optimizer_desc: Lets the provider lightly enhance your prompt before generation.
Video.prompt_expansion_desc: Useful when your prompt is very short and you want a richer interpretation.
Video.audio_flag_desc: For supported Wan modes, keeps the source audio in the final result.
Video.advanced_desc: Shows extra controls only for models that actually support them.
Video.advanced_empty: This model does not need any extra controls.
Video.negative_prompt_desc: Use it to remove unwanted details like blur, extra objects, bad anatomy or noise.
Video.negative_prompt_placeholder: What to avoid in the result: blur, distort, low quality...
Video.cfg_scale_desc: Higher values make the model follow the text prompt more strictly. Mostly relevant for Kling.
Video.seed_value_desc: Using the same number can produce a more similar result with the same settings.
Video.num_frames_desc: Used by Wan modes that define clip length with frame count instead of seconds.
Video.fps_desc: How many frames are shown per second. Higher values make motion smoother.
Video.guidance_scale: How strictly to follow the prompt
Video.guidance_scale_desc: Increase it when the model drifts too far away from your description.
Video.inference_steps_desc: More steps can improve quality, but they also make the generation heavier.
Video.shift_desc: Extra motion control used by some Wan models.
Video.watermark_text_desc: Adds a text watermark when the model supports it.
Video.character_ids_desc: Use this when you want to reuse saved characters in a new scene.
Video.origin_task_id_desc: Required when you want to continue or transform an existing video.
Video.timestamps_desc: Enter the part of the video you want to use, like 3.55,5.55.
Video.character_user_name_desc: Human-readable name for the saved character.
Video.character_prompt_desc: Briefly describe the character's look, mood or role.
Video.safety_instruction_desc: Extra guidance about what should not appear in the character or scene.
Video.kling_elements_desc: An extra block for finer scene control in more complex Kling 3.0 videos.
Video.multi_shot_desc: Splits the video into several separate shots instead of one continuous clip.
Video.shots_desc: Describe each shot and its duration.
Video.storyboard_desc: Add several scenes and set the duration for each one.

Audio.title: Audio
Audio.description: Create tracks, voiceovers, dubbing and dialogue scenes in one workspace.
Audio.make_public_tooltip: Allow others to see this audio
Audio.music_prompt_placeholder: Describe the music: style, mood, instruments...
Audio.premium_case_lyrics_desc: Go from a hook idea or a few lyric lines to a full pop track with chorus, verses and a strong reference-ready mood.
Audio.premium_case_lyrics_prompt: Emotional pop anthem about a neon city and second chances, female vocal, huge chorus, memorable hook and polished modern production.
Audio.premium_case_sfx_desc: Build trailer atmosphere, intros and scene sound design from text: whooshes, impacts, tension beds and cinematic texture.
Audio.premium_case_sfx_prompt: Cinematic sound design pack for a sci-fi trailer: deep impacts, metallic hits, neon whooshes, tense risers and a dark atmospheric low drone.
Audio.premium_case_tts_desc: Clean narration for videos, podcasts, ads and brand explainers.
Audio.premium_case_tts_prompt: Welcome to the new episode. Today we are showing how creators can launch music, voice and visuals from one workspace without unnecessary friction.
Audio.premium_case_cover_desc: Create a cover-style reinterpretation: define the era, genre and mood to get a familiar vibe in a new sonic direction.
Audio.premium_case_cover_prompt: Cover-style synthwave reinterpretation of a melancholic city-pop ballad with glossy drums, nostalgic pads, female vocal energy and neon-night atmosphere.
Audio.examples_title: Tracks and prompts to start from
Audio.examples_desc: Listen to ready demos first, then open the matching prompt and jump straight into generation.
Audio.featured_demos_desc: Hand-picked tracks you can play right away and open in the generator with the prompt already filled in.
